story.summaryZh: 在奥斯汀的各个社区受到欢迎后，我们一周中遇到的人们聚集在一起，庆祝这个城市的人们所喜爱的运动。
story.originalTitle: A week of new connections, a race day together. After being welcomed into communities across Austin, the people we met throughout the week came togeth...
story.summaryEn:
A week of new connections, a race day together.
After being welcomed into communities across Austin, the people we met throughout the week came together to round off a week shaped by the people who call this city home.
Thank you for letting us into your world and sharing the ways you celebrate our sport.
You. Us. Together. #USGP
detailZh:
一周的新连接，一起的赛车日。
在Austin的各个社区受到欢迎后，我们一周中遇到的人们聚集在一起，为这座城市的主人塑造的一周画上句号。
感谢你们让我们进入你们的世界，分享你们庆祝这项运动的方式。
你们。我们。一起。#USGP
detailEn:
A week of new connections, a race day together.
After being welcomed into communities across Austin, the people we met throughout the week came together to round off a week shaped by the people who call this city home.
